text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An irregularity was discovered in the 
Trainer's license. At this rate, they 
won't be able to accompany her to the 
Kikuka Sho. Forcing the issue could even 
lead to license suspension.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However... if they give up here, they 
won't be able to move forward with Neo 
Universe. Sensing this was a major turning 
point, the Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rushing over, casting everything else 
aside. In that sight, Neo Universe 
unmistakably sensed a fateful "something."
